# scylladbcloud_instance_types (Data Source)

The instance types available in a region, for cluster nodes or for vector search nodes.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Instance types for cluster nodes in us-east-1.
data "scylladbcloud_instance_types" "example" {
	region = "us-east-1"
}

# Instance types for vector search nodes.
data "scylladbcloud_instance_types" "vector" {
	region = "us-east-1"
	target = "VECTOR_SEARCH"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `region` (String) Cloud region, e.g. us-east-1.

### Optional

- `cloud` (String) Cloud provider, AWS or GCP.
- `target` (String) CLUSTER for cluster nodes or VECTOR_SEARCH for vector search nodes.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `instance_types` (List of Object) Instance types. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--instance_types))

<a id="nestedatt--instance_types"></a>
### Nested Schema for `instance_types`

Read-Only:

- `cpu_count` (Number)
- `family` (String)
- `instance_type_id` (Number)
- `memory` (Number)
- `name` (String)
- `total_storage` (Number)
